## Decision
Do not call the mid-segment churn issue fixed yet. The leading onboarding-trigger hypothesis remained plausible, but the evidence was not sufficient for a closure claim.

## Evidence still required
Review the third post-rollout cohort and confirm that the favorable retention pattern holds. Interpret it against the corrected 75–200-seat mid-segment cut; signup-source and tier cuts were clean, and the weaker second-cohort read was attributed to a one-off Customer Success auto-nudge outage rather than failure of the onboarding-trigger change. One favorable chart alone was not enough to establish the issue was fixed.

## Expected timing
The third cohort was expected the following week, with the next cut scheduled for April 25, 2023. Revisit the fixed/not-fixed claim after that evidence is available.
